segments.text: Ok so this is the Headless Interrupts page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, it says when the backend agent emits an interrupt, but no Antigravity backend for it is shown or linked.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the interrupting agent, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. With my own agent the approve and reject buttons work, but following the page nothing appears.
So basically, the interrupting backend is never shown.
Without guessing it, there's no pending decision at all.
So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
